method: Ten screenshots reviewed individually at full resolution in desktop and mobile sizes. The mobile note-panel overlap was corrected and rechecked. Browser interaction tests use an isolated real server with public fixtures.

records.review: Filtered Library: first file, clear counter and disabled Previous; desktop arrows and mobile touch targets fit.
Selected portrait owns note/favorite state. Mobile note editor stays below the canvas without covering toolbar or position.
Mixed Library video: arrows clear native playback controls; frame picking suppresses navigation.
Pagination failure retains the current file and navigation, with a readable error below the canvas.
Older page loaded in the same preview; final Next is disabled and one Back dismisses the viewer.
